name: Exp_ColorSchaffRSITrendCycle
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffRSITrendCycle custom indicator, which is a Schaff Trend Cycle applied to RSI values. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a low color zone to a higher one and sell positions on the reverse transition, with configurable buy/sell open/close toggles and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffRSITrendCycle自定义指标进行交易，该指标是将Schaff趋势周期应用于RSI值。当指标从低色区过渡到高色区时开多仓，反过渡时开空仓，并提供可配置的买卖开平仓开关和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Schaff趋势周期指标与RSI的结合，通过双RSI（快速RSI周期23，慢速RSI周期50）的循环计算产生震荡型趋势信号。入场条件：当Color缓冲区值大于5（上升趋势确立）且前一根K线的值小于6（刚从低位穿越）时开多仓；当值小于2（下降趋势确立）且前一根K线值大于1时开空仓。出场条件：上升趋势时如果启用了BuyPosClose则平多仓，下降趋势时如果启用了SellPosClose则平空仓，同时设有1000点止损和2000点止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的可用保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制比例或手数大小，默认0.1手固定手数模式。策略仅在新区块出现时计算信号，避免每tick重复计算，提高了效率。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on combining the Schaff Trend Cycle oscillator with dual RSI calculations (fast RSI period 23, slow RSI period 50) to generate trend-cycle signals. Entry conditions: a buy signal fires when the Color buffer value exceeds 5 (uptrend confirmed) and the previous bar's value was below 6 (just crossed upward from a low zone); a sell signal fires when the value drops below 2 (downtrend confirmed) and the previous bar's value was above 1. Exit conditions: long positions close when a downtrend signal appears and BuyPosClose is enabled; short positions close when an uptrend signal appears and SellPosClose is enabled, supplemented by a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit. Position sizing supports five margin modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 lots in fixed lot mode. The strategy only recalculates signals on new bars, avoiding redundant per-tick computation for better efficiency.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，手数或百分比
parameters.description_en: Deposit ratio or fixed lot; negative value for lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（可用保证金/余额/扣浮亏保证金/扣浮亏余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode (free margin/balance/free margin minus floating loss/balance minus floating loss/fixed lot)

pros: 使用Schaff趋势周期结合RSI的双周期分析，信号更具稳定性，减少了单纯RSI的频繁震荡
提供灵活的资金管理五种模式，适应不同风险偏好的交易者
买卖开平仓可独立开关控制，便于只做单边或只做信号平仓的策略组合
仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免了每tick重复计算的冗余开销
止损和止盈参数可配置，默认2:1的盈亏比提供了正向期望的基础
pros_en: Combines Schaff Trend Cycle with dual-period RSI for more stable signals, reducing the frequent oscillation typical of plain RSI
Offers five flexible money management modes to suit traders with different risk preferences
Independent toggle switches for buy/sell open and close operations allow one-direction-only or signal-close-only strategy combinations
Signal calculation only occurs on new bar formation, avoiding redundant per-tick computation overhead
Configurable stop loss and take profit with a default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio providing a foundation for positive expectancy
cons: 缺少点差过滤，在H4周期影响较小但在更短周期可能导致不利成交
指标Color缓冲区的阈值判断（大于5/小于2）使用了硬编码的魔术数字，缺乏对指标值域的明确说明
没有检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能反复开仓导致仓位叠加风险
依赖外部自定义指标ColorSchaffRSITrendCycle，缺少该指标的源码则无法验证信号逻辑
LoadHistory和GlobalVariableDel_等函数依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，增加了外部依赖和调试难度
cons_en: Lacks a spread filter which could lead to unfavorable fills especially if used on shorter timeframes
Hard-coded magic numbers (greater than 5 / less than 2) for Color buffer thresholds lack documentation on the indicator's value range
No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially leading to repeated entries and position stacking
Depends on the external custom indicator ColorSchaffRSITrendCycle; without its source code the signal logic cannot be independently verified
Functions like LoadHistory and GlobalVariableDel_ depend on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, adding external dependency and debugging complexity
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致风险暴露过大
添加点差过滤和最小盈利点数检查，提高实际成交质量
improvements_en: Add position existence checks before opening new trades to prevent same-direction position stacking and excessive risk exposure
Implement spread filtering and minimum profit point validation to improve actual execution quality

risk_points: 无同方向持仓检查可能导致仓位叠加，风险敞口超出预期
硬编码的Color缓冲区阈值缺乏文档说明，可能因指标版本变化产生错误信号
依赖外部指标和库文件，若缺少或版本不匹配可能导致EA无法运行或信号异常
risk_points_en: No same-direction position check may cause position stacking and risk exposure beyond expectations
Hard-coded Color buffer thresholds lack documentation and may produce incorrect signals if the indicator version changes
Dependency on external indicator and library files; missing or mismatched versions can cause the EA to fail or generate abnormal signals
